name: The Dark
source: Maiku is a normal guy, he has his own life, friends and plans. His life changes dramaticly after a traffic accident. He is blind now. Then he meets Aya - partially blind girl - he falls in love with.
translation: 麦克原本只是个普通人，有自己的生活、朋友和计划。一场交通事故使他的人生发生剧变，他从此失明。后来，他遇见了视力部分受损的女孩绫，并爱上了她。
